```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(tidyverse)
library(Signac)
library(writexl)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbname = "../../TOBIAS.dr.h12_191124.sqlite")
```

```{r}
# Create a composite index on CT_data for (chr, start, end) if it doesn't already exist
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_CT_data_chr_start_end 
  ON CT_data(chr, start, end);
")

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tobias_upper_TF_gene_name ON tobias(UPPER(TF_gene_name));
")

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ct_data_upper_target_gene_name ON ct_data(UPPER(target_gene_name));
")
```

```{r}
set1.feat <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT DISTINCT t.features, t.TF_gene_name
FROM tobias t
JOIN acc a ON t.features = a.features
WHERE UPPER(t.TF_gene_name) IN (SELECT UPPER(ct.target_gene_name) FROM ct_data ct GROUP BY ct.target_gene_name UNION SELECT 'COE1') AND (
    (t.PRO1_2_bound = 1 AND a.PRO1_2 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GL3_4_bound = 1 AND a.GL3_4 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GA5_6_bound = 1 AND a.GA5_6 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GL5_bound   = 1 AND a.GL5   > 0.5) OR
    (t.CO1_2_bound = 1 AND a.CO1_2 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GA1_2_bound = 1 AND a.GA1_2 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GA3_4_bound = 1 AND a.GA3_4 > 0.5) OR
    (t.GL1_2_bound = 1 AND a.GL1_2 > 0.5)
  );
")
```

```{r}
set2.feat <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT DISTINCT t.features, t.TF_gene_name
FROM tobias t
JOIN acc a ON t.features = a.features
WHERE UPPER(t.TF_gene_name) IN (SELECT UPPER(ct.target_gene_name) FROM ct_data ct GROUP BY ct.target_gene_name UNION SELECT 'COE1') AND (
    (t.PRO1_2_bound = 0 AND a.PRO1_2 < 0.5) AND
    (t.GL3_4_bound = 0 AND a.GL3_4 < 0.5) AND
    (t.GA5_6_bound = 0 AND a.GA5_6 < 0.5) AND

    (t.GA3_4_bound = 0 AND a.GA3_4 < 0.5) AND
    (t.GL1_2_bound = 0 AND a.GL1_2 < 0.5)
  );
  ")
```


```{r TAL1}
gene <- "TAL1"
set1.gr <- StringToGRanges(filter(set1.feat, TF_gene_name==gene) %>% pull(features))
set2.gr <- StringToGRanges(filter(set2.feat, TF_gene_name==gene) %>% pull(features))
over.1 <-length(findOverlaps(set1.gr, ct.gr))
over.2 <-length(findOverlaps(set2.gr, ct.gr))

# Create a data frame with the two values
results <- data.frame(
  Set = c("Bound & Open Set", "Unbound and Closed Set"),
  Footprint_CT_overlap_Count = c(over.1, over.2)
)

# Print the table using knitr::kable with a caption and row names
knitr::kable(results, caption = paste0(gene), row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Example gene vector; replace with your genes
genes <- c("TAL1", "GATA2", "GATA3","VSX2","EBF1","INSM1")

# Create an initial data frame with row names for the sets
results_df <- data.frame(
  Set = c("Bound & Open Features", "Unbound & Closed Features"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop over each gene to get CT features and compute overlaps
for(gene in genes) {
  
  # Query the database for CT features corresponding to the current gene.
  # The query uses UPPER() to force a case-insensitive match.
  query <- sprintf("
    SELECT DISTINCT ct.feature
    FROM ct_data ct
    WHERE UPPER(ct.target_gene_name) = UPPER('%s');
  ", gene)
  ct.feat <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
  
  # Convert the CT features into GRanges
  ct.gr <- StringToGRanges(ct.feat$feature)
  
  # Get GRanges for the features from set1 and set2 for this gene
  set1.gr <- StringToGRanges(filter(set1.feat, TF_gene_name == ifelse(gene=="EBF1","COE1",gene)) %>% pull(features))
  set2.gr <- StringToGRanges(filter(set2.feat, TF_gene_name == ifelse(gene=="EBF1","COE1",gene)) %>% pull(features))
  
  # Count the overlaps between the CT regions and the two sets
  over1 <- length(findOverlaps(set1.gr, ct.gr))
  over2 <- length(findOverlaps(set2.gr, ct.gr))
  
  # Add a new column to the results data frame named after the gene,
  # with the two overlap counts as rows.
  results_df[[gene]] <- c(over1, over2)
}

# Print the final table using knitr::kable with a caption
knitr::kable(results_df, caption = "Footprint - C&T Overlap Counts per Gene", row.names = FALSE)
write_xlsx(results_df, path = "../analysis/Footprint_CT_Overlap_Counts_per_Gene.xlsx")
```
